title: Projects Master & Team Assignments
subtitle: Monitor client projects, milestone billings, internal team assignments, and revenue recognition methods.
card_desc: Master reference for purchase orders, budgets, milestone billings, and profit sharing.
empty_desc: Projects directory is currently empty. Add a new project to start procurement and invoicing cycles.
not_found_desc: Return to Projects Master list to select a valid project.

header.title: Client Project Documents & Milestones
header.subtitle: Manage formal project contractual binding, compliance documents (SPK, BAKP, UAT, BAST), milestone schedules, and progress revenue recognition.

milestones.card_desc: Configure portions and milestone billing schedule until exactly 100%.
milestones.btn_reset_disabled_title: Milestone schedule cannot be re-structured because some milestones are already used in a BAKP or Invoice. Use the Edit button to modify available rows.
milestones.empty_desc: Set up milestone payment schedule for this project.
milestones.progress_card_desc: Record period-end cumulative progress for automated accrual revenue recognition.
milestones.empty_progress_desc: Record project progress at fiscal period close to recognize accrual revenue in line with project achievements.

quotations.card_desc: Issue official project quotation and download PDF document.
quotations.empty_desc: Create the first formal price quotation for this project.

client_po.card_desc: Verify incoming POs from Buyer Portal before project billing.
client_po.empty_desc: POs submitted by clients through the Buyer Portal will appear here for verification.

sow_spk.card_desc: Manage project scope of work (SoW) and SPK contracts.
sow_spk.empty_title: No SoW or SPK Documents Yet
sow_spk.empty_desc: Add a Work Order (SPK) contract or Statement of Work specification document.

acceptance.bakp_desc: Mandatory requirement before issuing a Progress Milestone Invoice.
acceptance.btn_bakp_disabled_title: Set up 100% milestone schedule on the Milestones & Progress tab before issuing a BAKP.
acceptance.empty_bakp_desc: Create a Work Progress Certificate to validate achievement of project milestones.
acceptance.uat_desc: UAT must be marked Accepted before a BAST can be issued.
acceptance.empty_uat_desc: Record system acceptance testing results performed by client representatives.

export.toast_excel_success: Projects list successfully exported to Excel (.xlsx).
export.pdf_subtitle: Total: {{count}} Registered Projects | Altvira Financial ERP
export.toast_csv_success: Projects list successfully exported to CSV (.csv).

modal.edit_desc: Update project details, contract value, or status.
modal.create_desc: Register a new project for milestone billing and budgeting references.
modal.team_assignment_desc: Select internal team members assigned to this project.
modal.field_notes_ph: Scope notes, contract references, or specific terms...
modal.view_desc: Brief project summary, contract value, and team assignment.

buyer_portal.page_subtitle: Track project progress, download official billing documents, and submit purchase orders independently.
buyer_portal.card_lookup_desc: For confidentiality between clients, matching is performed server-side and only displays one matching project with rate limiting per IP.
buyer_portal.milestones_desc: Read-only information on completion stages and billing for your contract.
buyer_portal.empty_milestones_desc: Milestone schedule will appear once the PO is verified and the project is activated.
buyer_portal.docs_desc: Quotation, SoW, SPK, BAKP, UAT, BAST, Invoice, and Receipts associated with this PO Number.
buyer_portal.empty_docs_desc: Official documents will appear automatically as project phases progress.
buyer_portal.form_desc: Once submitted, the system issues a PO Number with a unique code <1>PO-YYYYMM-XXXXXX</1>.
buyer_portal.items_box_desc: Add a list of work packages along with quantities and estimated unit prices.
buyer_portal.security_footer_notice: Public endpoint is protected by Cloudflare Turnstile verification & rate limiting on production server.
buyer_portal.toast_turnstile_required: Please complete the Cloudflare Turnstile security verification first.
buyer_portal.toast_submit_success: Client PO successfully submitted with code {{poNumber}}.
buyer_portal.modal_save_instruction: Please save and copy the PO code/number above carefully to monitor work progress and download official documents. Once this dialog is closed, all submission form fields will be reset to empty.
buyer_portal.toast_download_word_fail: Failed to download Word PO document.
buyer_portal.doc_pdf_notice: This official document copy is downloaded via the Altcycles Buyer Portal using client unique PO Number verification without revealing internal company cost data.
